verdict.rationale: A documented public API is a fair question for a corporate-compliance and registered-agent service like CT Corporation, so the axis applies. The evidence pack only records that robots.txt on www.wolterskluwer.com returned a Cloudflare challenge and that legacy CT pages redirect into that walled host. No API documentation, endpoints, or developer portal was observed, so the capability is unevidenced rather than inapplicable.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API
